name: Huayna Potosí
why: The 6,088 m peak an hour from La Paz: an ice climb on a glacier ridge, and from the top the Altiplano, Lake Titicaca and the Amazon clouds.
book: Only with a licensed mountain guide from La Paz: crampons, ice axe, rope and harness. 3 days with nights at the refuges.
water: Meals and melted snow at the refuges.
dangers: Crevasses and seracs on the glacier.
Altitude 6,088 m: at least a week in La Paz first.
turnaround: The guide turns back at 07:00 wherever you are.
